bio.jane/contract.noReading: A format conversion: the same tree written in another format, with nothing inferred.
bio.jane/contract.question: What does this tree look like in Newick, NEXUS, PhyloXML or NeXML?

description: Convert a tree between the four formats this workbench reads and writes — Newick, NEXUS, PhyloXML and NeXML — sniffing the input format rather than making the caller declare it. Newick loses annotations the richer formats carry, which is why the conversion is a step you choose rather than something done silently on export.

_files.description: The project: record references shaped like _subject. Their records become library documents a tool names in sequences/parts/document; a trace or alignment is found by file name.

_subject.description: The record to act on: exactly one of sequence, accession (+source), sample (an id from list_samples) or file ({name, text} or {name, base64}); record_index picks one record of several.

format.description: the format to write. Values: newick (Newick), nexus (NEXUS), phyloxml (PhyloXML), nexml (NeXML).

name.description: the tree's name inside the written file (NEXUS and NeXML carry one). Advanced.

tree.description: the tree, in any of the four formats.

name: export_tree

sourceFormat.description: the format the input was sniffed as — check this when a conversion surprises you

text.description: the tree written in the requested format
